Eastern Coalfields Limited (ECL) has released the official notification for the post of Advisor (Geology). The last date to submit the offline application is 05 December 2026. Further details are available at easterncoalfields.in.

ECL Quick Summary

Eastern Coalfields Limited (ECL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, is engaging one (01) full time Advisor (Geology) on contract basis, open only to retired E8 grade executives or equivalent from CIL and its subsidiaries, PSUs and Autonomous Organizations of Central / State Government. The application, with the prescribed format and documents, must reach the office of HOD(EE), ECL, Sanctoria by Registered Post / Speed Post, or be sent to [email protected], by 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026.

The official notification does not mention an application fee.

About ECL

Eastern Coalfields Limited is a subsidiary of Coal India Limited (CIL). The application office named in the notice is at Sanctoria, P.S. Dishergarh, Burdwan, West Bengal. The Advisor (Geology) will be stationed at ECL HQ and will hand over all records at the end of the engagement to the HOD (Geology), ECL HQ.

Where and How to Send

The application format can be downloaded from the ECL website www.easterncoalfields.in under the caption "Recruitment Notices". The same format is printed at the end of the notification. Candidates submit their resume and the application format with the self-attested documents listed under Enclosures.

  1. Fill in the application format for the post of Advisor (Geology) in Eastern Coalfields Limited (16 points, followed by a declaration, signature with date and list of enclosures).
  2. Attach your resume and the self-attested documents named in the notice.
  3. By post: send by Registered Post / Speed Post to the office of HOD(EE), ECL, Sanctoria, P.S. Dishergarh, Pin-713333, Burdwan (W.B).
  4. On the envelope, superscribe "Application for the post of Advisor (Geology), ECL".
  5. By email: send to [email protected] with the subject "Application for the post of Advisor (Geology), ECL".
  6. The application must reach within 15 days from the date of notification (including Sundays and holidays), that is, by 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026.

Applications received by email or post after 05:00 PM on 05 December 2026 in the office of GM/HOD (HR/EE), ECL will not be considered. ECL will not be responsible for any postal delay or loss in transit.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

There is one post: Advisor (Geology), full time, on contractual basis.

  • Eligible applicants: retired E8 grade executive or equivalent, from CIL and its subsidiaries, PSUs / Autonomous Organizations of Central / State Government.
  • Qualification: PG in Geology.
  • Work experience: minimum 15 years of experience related to Geology.
  • Preference: preference will be given to the candidate having sound technical knowledge and adequate experience in the Raniganj Coalfields.
  • Age limit: above 60 and not more than 65 years during the contract period.
  • Not eligible: VRS optees will not be considered.

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

Remuneration and Other Benefits

Consolidated monthly compensation / honorarium is paid as per the equivalent grade of CIL.

Grade of Retired ExecutiveMonthly Compensation / Honorarium
For superannuated E8 Grade ExecutiveRs.1,20,000/-
  • Conveyance: the company shall provide conveyance as per availability; where it is not provided, the Advisor is eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charges.
  • Accommodation: suitable company accommodation on availability; if not available, HRA as per the CIL HRA Rules for X, Y and Z class of cities, based on the DOE circular OM dated 07.07.2017.
  • Mobile phone: reimbursement based on actual bills or ₹1000/- p.m., whichever is less.
  • Medical: CIL executives covered under the post retiral benefits scheme continue under that scheme; appointees not on the roll of CIL get the same coverage if they are not covered under any post retiral benefit scheme.
  • Leave: paid leave of 15 (fifteen) days in every six months spell, in addition to paid holidays, regulated as per CIL Executive Leave Rules; not encashable, and accumulated leave lapses on expiry of each period of engagement.
  • TA / DA on official tour: as per entitlement on retirement, restricted to air travel by Economy class only.
  • Joining and exit travel: cost of one ticket (for self) if travelling from out-station to join, and one ticket (for self) on expiry of contract.
  • Hotel: as per entitlement at retirement / superannuation, limited to Single Room; DA as admissible at retirement if boarding and lodging is not provided.
  • GST: where payment of GST is required, it is reimbursed on production of proof of payment.

ECL Advisor (Geology) Job Description

  • Provide expert guidance - Geological domain.
  • Oversee activities and advise for smooth functioning and effective implementation of activities related to Geology, Underground Coal Gasification, Geo-Technical related work, New Initiative, Mine Closure and Repurposing.
  • Monitor the Geotechnical Lab & NABL Accreditation.
  • Assist in formulating strategies for transparent and cost-effective process.
  • Recommend best practices.
  • Advise on policy frameworks.
  • Capacity Building of the Department for being self-reliant in their respective domain.
  • Any other jobs assigned as per requirement.

Enclosures

  • Resume
  • Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate)
  • Superannuation notice
  • Office order / Official Document / certification from the respective organization regarding Gratuity and Retiral Dues, etc.
  • Certificates of qualification
  • Experience Certificate with Promotion details throughout the career
  • Certificate of Scale of Pay

All documents must be self-attested. The application format also asks for EIS No. (if retired from CIL), caste, date of birth, experience details (whether worked for at least 15 years in Geology Department), employment details till superannuation, any pending Vigilance / Departmental / Safety / Court / Police case, and the Superannuation Notice No. & Date.

Selection Process

ECL reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview / selection process for the notified post. No T.A. will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview / selection process. The engagement is subject to medical fitness certified by the Company Medical Officer.

Important Dates

EventDate
Date of notification20.11.2026
Last date for receipt of application (post / email)05.12.2026, 05:00 PM

Important Instructions

  • The contract period is initially one (01) year, which may be extended depending upon requirement and satisfactory performance.
  • Notice period for termination: one month's notice or consolidated compensation amount from either side; otherwise the engagement ends automatically at the end of the period in the offer letter.
  • The Advisor must join within 15 days of the offer of engagement (or in exceptional circumstances, as approved by the concerned Functional Director); otherwise the offer stands withdrawn.
  • The Advisor gives proposals and advice in writing under signature, but will not supervise day to day work of employees nor certify or pass bills.
  • The Advisor shall not accept any other full-time appointment, advisory or administrative, in any firm or company during the engagement.
  • All information gathered must be kept in strict confidence, during and after the engagement.
  • Rules of promotion on Vigilance / Departmental / Safety Clearances apply; other terms follow CIL's policy for engaging retired CMDs / Directors / Sr. Level Executives as Advisors.
  • ECL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies and cancel / restrict / modify / alter the engagement process without notice. Any modification will be given on the ECL website only.

Candidates can apply online until 3 December 2026 at 6 PM through bemlindia.in. Check the post-wise vacancies, qualifications, experience, age limits, ₹40,000–₹2,60,000 pay scales, application fee and selection process.

BEML Limited has released the BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 notification for 83 vacancies in various executive grades. The recruitment includes Engineer, Assistant Manager, Manager, Senior Manager, Assistant General Manager, Deputy General Manager and General Manager positions in engineering, project management, research and development, manufacturing and other specialised functions. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official BEML website, bemlindia.in. The last date for submitting the application is 3 December 2026 at 6:00 PM.

According to Advertisement No. KP/S/18/2026 dated 16 October 2026, applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and relevant post-qualification experience for their chosen position. The recruitment covers Grade II to Grade VIII, with advertised pay scales ranging from ₹40,000–₹1,40,000 to ₹1,00,000–₹2,60,000. The upper age limit varies from 29 to 48 years depending on the grade, with applicable relaxations. Candidates should review the position-specific eligibility requirements before applying because qualifications, experience and technical responsibilities differ considerably between posts.

BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, post-qualification experience and age requirements specified for the position code. Eligibility will be determined as on 3 December 2026.

Educational Qualification

Most technical positions require a full-time, first-class Engineering degree in the relevant discipline from a recognised university or institution. The accepted specialisations include Mechanical, Electrical, Electrical and Electronics, Automobile, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Thermal Engineering and other disciplines according to the post.

Certain positions require specialised qualifications, such as a postgraduate degree in Hindi or English with the specified language combination, a translation qualification, or recognised safety-related credentials.

The notification defines first class as at least 60% aggregate marks across all semesters or years. The qualifying-mark requirement is relaxed by five percentage points for eligible SC, ST and PwD candidates. Applicants with CGPA or credit-based grading must provide the university-approved conversion formula.

Important: A general Engineering degree does not make a candidate eligible for every advertised position. Applicants must possess the discipline-specific qualification and technical experience stated against their chosen position code.

BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Experience Requirements

BEML requires relevant post-qualification experience for most executive positions. Experience acquired before obtaining the essential qualification will not be counted towards the prescribed requirement.

These are the grade-level minimum requirements. The detailed advertisement prescribes additional relevant-domain experience for individual positions, including rolling stock projects, engineering design, diesel engines, manufacturing, cybersecurity, testing, commissioning and other specialised functions.

Important Experience Conditions

  • Only relevant experience gained after obtaining the prescribed qualification will be considered.
  • Private-sector experience must meet the employment conditions prescribed in the advertisement.
  • Freelance experience will not be counted as post-qualification experience.
  • Candidates applying for DGM and GM positions must provide their current reporting structure.
  • Private-sector applicants for General Manager must satisfy the company's specified annual turnover requirement of at least ₹1,000 crore.
  • Experienced candidates must provide a description of at least 150 words for each relevant experience entry in the online application.

The experience description should clearly explain the projects, assignments, responsibilities, position held and duration. BEML warns that unclear or irrelevant information may lead to rejection of the application.

In addition to basic pay, selected employees may receive applicable dearness allowance, company accommodation or house rent allowance, provident fund, gratuity, performance-related pay and other benefits according to company rules.

BEML specifies that basic pay is normally fixed at the minimum of the applicable pay scale, although higher starting pay may be considered for deserving candidates. The pay-scale figures should not be interpreted as monthly take-home salary.

BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

BEML will shortlist eligible candidates for assessment based on the applications received and the relevant eligibility criteria. The company may restrict the number of candidates called for assessment and increase the qualifying percentage depending on the number of applicants.

The recruitment process includes the following applicable stages:

  1. Screening and shortlisting of eligible applications.
  2. Assessment of shortlisted candidates through the process notified by BEML.
  3. Verification of original documents and eligibility claims.
  4. Pre-employment medical examination.
  5. Final selection and appointment, subject to satisfactory verification and medical fitness.

The advertisement does not prescribe a single common written-examination pattern for all 83 executive vacancies. Candidates should follow subsequent official notices for assessment dates and methods.

BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements

Candidates employed in Central or State Government departments, autonomous bodies, quasi-government organisations and public sector undertakings must follow the proper-channel or No Objection Certificate requirements prescribed by BEML.

Such candidates may forward a printout of their online application through the proper channel within 10 days after the advertisement's closing date, addressed to the Assistant General Manager, Recruitment Cell, BEML Soudha, BEML Limited, 23/1, 4th Main, S.R. Nagar, Bengaluru - 560027.

Alternatively, they may produce a position-specific NOC from their present employer at the assessment stage. The notification also explains circumstances in which applicants without an NOC may attend the interview, subject to furnishing a proper relieving letter at joining and forgoing certain past-service benefits or pay protection.

Documents Required for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the required documents while submitting their online applications. BEML states that applications without the prescribed documents will be rejected.

  • Class 10 marksheet and SSLC certificate showing date of birth.
  • Class 12 marksheet.
  • Qualifying degree certificate and marksheets.
  • CGPA or credit-to-percentage conversion formula, where applicable.
  • Postgraduate degree certificate and marksheets, where applicable.
  • Government-issued identity proof.
  • Detailed resume.
  • Applicable SC, ST, OBC, EWS or PwD certificate.
  • Experience certificates showing the start and end dates of employment.
  • Latest payslip.
  • Current reporting structure for DGM and GM applicants.
  • Company turnover credentials for relevant General Manager applicants.

Applicants should ensure the uploaded documents support their claims regarding qualifications, post-qualification experience, reservation and other eligibility requirements.

How to Apply Online for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply through the official BEML careers website. Online registration is scheduled to remain available until 6:00 PM on 3 December 2026.

  1. Visit the official BEML website at bemlindia.in.
  2. Open the Careers section.
  3. Locate Advertisement No. KP/S/18/2026 for Recruitment of Executives.
  4. Read the detailed notification and identify the appropriate position code.
  5. Open the corresponding online application facility if available.
  6. Complete registration using a valid email address and mobile number.
  7. Enter the required personal, educational and employment details.
  8. Provide relevant post-qualification experience details, including the required description of at least 150 words for each experience entry.
  9. Upload the required qualification, experience, identity, category and other documents.
  10. Pay the applicable application fee, if required.
  11. Review the entered information and submit the completed application before the deadline.
  12. Save the registration details and submitted application for future reference.

Important: The notification directs candidates to apply for a single position that best matches their qualifications and experience. Applicants should select the correct position code rather than submitting applications for multiple posts.
